label: Website Redesign
description: Transform an existing site while preserving useful content and functionality; approval before the major redesign is implemented.

tasks.title: Inspect the request and existing site
tasks.mission: Structure the redesign request and record what the imported baseline contains. Facts only.

tasks.title: Content inventory and preservation list
tasks.mission: Inventory existing content; list what must be preserved and what is weak.

tasks.title: Baseline SEO audit
tasks.mission: Audit the imported baseline for SEO and identify equity to preserve.

tasks.title: Baseline design critique
tasks.mission: What works and must be preserved; what hurts hierarchy, UX and polish.

tasks.title: Baseline visual QA
tasks.mission: Render the current site at all viewports and record its visual problems (baseline for comparison).

tasks.title: Redesign requirements
tasks.mission: Consolidate audits into prioritised redesign requirements and acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Brand voice continuity
tasks.mission: Derive the voice from the existing site; keep continuity unless asked otherwise.

tasks.title: Redesign architecture
tasks.mission: Improved structure preserving URLs and valuable content; list every change with its reason.

tasks.title: Redesigned design system
tasks.mission: Evolve the visual language into a premium, accessible system without discarding recognisable brand elements.

tasks.title: Copy revisions
tasks.mission: Revise copy only where the plan requires, preserving valuable content.

tasks.title: Conversion review
tasks.mission: Review revised copy and structure.

tasks.title: Approve the redesign direction
tasks.mission: Human approval gate before the major redesign is implemented.

tasks.title: Implement the redesign
tasks.mission: Improve the existing implementation (current site files are provided) according to the improvement architecture, design system and approved copy. Preserve valuable existing content, URLs and brand assets; change only what the plan calls for. Return every changed file in full.

tasks.title: Design critique of the implementation
tasks.mission: Strict review of the rendered implementation (hierarchy, spacing, typography, originality, polish) against the design system and ApexWeb anti-slop rules. Reject with precise fixes if it looks generic, templated or over-decorated.

tasks.title: Independent UX review
tasks.mission: Walk the primary journeys in the blueprint and report friction with element-level fixes.

tasks.title: Independent bug hunt
tasks.mission: Find runtime errors, broken interactions and defects using the bug scan evidence.

tasks.title: Responsive verification
tasks.mission: Verify behaviour at 360/768/1440px using rendered measurements; report defects with selector, viewport and CSS fix.

tasks.title: Accessibility audit
tasks.mission: Audit against WCAG 2.2 AA using axe results and a manual review of semantics, keyboard flow and focus states.

tasks.title: Performance audit
tasks.mission: Audit loading performance using the measured mobile probe (LCP, CLS, bytes, render-blocking) and the files; give concrete fixes.

tasks.title: On-page SEO audit of the implementation
tasks.mission: Audit the built pages against the SEO strategy using the seo_audit output: metadata, headings, JSON-LD validity, internal links, sitemap/robots. Return a review with fixes.

tasks.title: Main Agent triage of review findings
tasks.mission: Consider every independent reviewer finding. Accept the ones that are evidenced and genuinely improve the result (assign each to the right specialist with the fix); reject duplicates, subjective nitpicks and anything contradicting the blueprint, with reasons.

tasks.title: Visual QA loop
tasks.mission: Render desktop, tablet and mobile, analyse screenshots and region checks, compare with the previous pass, and reject with concrete fixes until no critical or major visual issue remains.

tasks.title: Final QA and release check
tasks.mission: Run the final release checks. Approve only if there are no deterministic hard failures and no unresolved critical issues; evaluate every blueprint requirement (result.requirement_checks). Otherwise reject with the exact fixes required.

tasks.title: Handoff package documentation
tasks.mission: Write docs/HANDOFF.md (what was built, structure, how to deploy and edit, every [[PLACEHOLDER]] the client must replace, open items, configuration notes) and docs/CHANGELOG.md strictly from the task log.
